data.title: Circle to Become Chelsea's Principal Front-of-Shirt Sponsor for 2026/27 Season
data.description:
Circle announced on Aug. 28 that USDC and Circle branding will become Chelsea's principal front-of-shirt sponsorship across the club's men's, women's and academy teams for the 2026/27 season. According to NS3.AI, the strategy is designed to make the dollar-linked stablecoin more familiar to football fans, even if they do not immediately understand or use it.

The deal also raises questions about how financial products are marketed through football sponsorships.

data.title: Revolut and Bridge Launch EURR Issuance for Select Customers in Three Countries
data.description: Revolut has launched EURR issuance with licensed issuer Bridge, opening the first batch to select customers in three countries. According to Odaily, Bridge’s EURR supply stands at 374, while Circle’s EURC supply is 394.5 million euros.

data.title: ETH Faces $1.15 Billion Long Liquidations Below $2,509, Coinglass Data Shows
data.description: Coinglass data shows that if ETH falls below $2,509, cumulative long liquidations across major centralized exchanges could reach $1.147 billion. According to ChainCatcher, if ETH rises above $2,767, cumulative short liquidations across major centralized exchanges could reach $761 million.

data.title: Hyperliquid's HYPE Rises 78% as SEC Grants Relief for Tokenized Stock Trading
data.description: Hyperliquid's HYPE token rose 78% over 30 days, while Uniswap's UNI gained 142%, after the SEC granted temporary, conditional relief for venues trading tokenized stocks. According to NS3.AI, the order allows tokenized securities venues to trade National Market System stocks through automated market makers and liquidity pools. The gains also reflect rising trading activity and expectations surrounding Hyperliquid's possible US expansion.

data.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post $6.2 Million Weekly Inflow as Ether Funds End Four-Week Run
data.description:
U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs took in $433 million on Friday, helping the group finish the week ending Sept. 18 with a $6.2 million net inflow. According to NS3.AI, Fidelity's FBTC accounted for $310.7 million of the bitcoin funds' Friday inflow.

Spot ether ETFs also received $143.8 million on Friday, but the category still logged a $140 million weekly outflow and ended a four-week inflow streak. The figures were based on The Block's analysis of SoSoValue data.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Crypto Futures Linked to Anthropic Reach $79.27 Million in Open Interest
data.description: Crypto futures linked to Anthropic have reached about $79.27 million in open interest as traders position around a potential IPO that investors have discussed valuing at up to $2 trillion. According to NS3.AI, the activity comes before Anthropic has disclosed an offering price, final valuation or number of shares, although the company confidentially filed a draft registration statement with the SEC in June. The Wall Street Journal reported that Anthropic plans to stage the IPO in November, later than the October timetable previously expected by investors.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Trump’s Kennedy Center Plans Face Legal Hurdles
data.description:
President Donald Trump’s plans for the Kennedy Center are facing legal roadblocks as questions grow over the landmark’s future, according to Bloomberg.

Bloomberg’s Shaquille Omari said the dispute over one of Washington’s most iconic cultural institutions is escalating.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Turkey Detains Finance Executives in Funds Scheme Probe
data.description: Turkish authorities detained high-profile finance executives on Saturday in an investigation into a “ponzi-like” funds scheme, NTV said according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Wendy’s Franchisee Files Bankruptcy, Citing Weak Brand Marketing
data.description: One of the largest Wendy’s franchisees in the US has filed for bankruptcy, citing rising beef costs and reduced frequency and effectiveness of Wendy’s brand marketing under the burger chain’s previous management, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: U.S. President Donald Trump Says U.S. Will Support and Oversee AI Industry Growth
data.description:
U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not block the development of the artificial intelligence industry, but will support and oversee its growth. According to ChainCatcher, he announced plans to establish an AI task force and said he will appoint an AI czar in the future.

Trump said the government will not use restrictive measures to suppress AI innovation, but will rely on the existing judicial system to address illegal activity in the AI sector.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Chainalysis Finds Scam Operations Linked to AI Vendors Earn More On-Chain Revenue
data.description: AI is lowering the cost of impersonation and persuasion, which may let smaller criminal groups carry out more fraud without hiring additional workers. According to NS3.AI, Chainalysis found average on-chain revenue of $3.2 million for scam operations with observed links to AI vendors, compared with $719,000 for operations without those links, although the data does not prove AI caused the difference. As automated conversations become cheaper, the report said defenses may need to focus more on stopping payments and recovering funds than on wasting scammers' time.

data.title: Universal Announces Shutdown of Cross-Chain Asset Protocol
data.description:
Universal has announced it will shut down its cross-chain asset protocol. The protocol will continue normal operations for the next 60 days, until November 17, 2026. According to ChainCatcher, Universal launched two years ago to build Universal Assets, or uAssets, bringing assets such as SOL, XRP, and DOGE into a new ecosystem, with more than 80 assets supported.

The team said adoption has not reached a level that is sustainable in the long term, prompting the shutdown decision. During the wind-down period, uAssets will remain backed by underlying assets, and users will be able to sell through the Universal app or redeem the underlying assets through the mint-and-redeem interface. Larger redemptions can be coordinated by contacting contact@universal.xyz. After November 17, remaining uAssets will be redeemed through smart contracts: six uAssets on Base will correspond to SOL, cbXRP, cbDOGE, cbADA, cbBTC, and cbLTC, while all others will be redeemed as USDC. The final plan will be announced before the shutdown.

data.title: Solana Rises to $111.78 as Spot ETFs Draw More Than $28 Million in Inflows
data.description:
Solana rose to $111.78, its highest level since January, after breaking above the $110 resistance level and climbing 85% above its year-to-date low. According to NS3.AI, spot Solana ETFs recorded more than $28 million in inflows this month, while more than 439 million SOL tokens were staked.

The article said technical analysis points to a $150 target for Solana. It added that a drop below $96 would invalidate the bullish outlook.

data.title: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act Stalls After Congress Reviews Crypto Oversight Bill
data.description:
The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act is dead, at least for now, after Congress considered legislation to define types of cryptocurrencies and related assets. According to NS3.AI, the bill would have clarified which regulators had authority over different digital assets.

SEC Chairman Paul Atkins said the agency needed a law to support its work, but Congress did not pass one.

data.title: Salesforce Forecasts More Than $63 Billion in Fiscal 2030 Revenue at Dreamforce
data.description: According to CNBC, Salesforce forecast more than $63 billion in fiscal year 2030 revenue at its Dreamforce Investor Day, above the $59.2 billion analysts expected, and unveiled AIforce, a live interface across its ecosystem, along with Koa, its first reasoning model developed with Nvidia. The company also said it has bought back a cumulative $60 billion of stock. The article also said the Dow fell 1.7% last week for its third straight weekly loss, while the S&P 500 slipped 0.08% and the Nasdaq gained 0.7%. It said the Federal Reserve raised rates by a quarter percentage point to a range of 3.75% to 4%, its first hike in three years, and that West Texas Intermediate crude and Brent crude hit their highest levels since the middle of May before easing later in the week.

data.title: Polymarket Karmine Corp Match Winner Odds Swing 20% in LEC Playoff Market
data.description: Polymarket’s “match winner” market for the LoL playoff event between Karmine Corp and Movistar KOI saw Karmine Corp’s implied win probability swing sharply from 72.5% one hour earlier to 52.5%, a 20 percentage point move. According to ChainCatcher, the sudden change may reflect the impact of breaking news.

data.title: Grayscale's Zcash ETF Nears $1 Billion in Net Assets After Aug. 25 Listing
data.description: Grayscale’s Zcash ETF has accumulated $914.53 million in net assets, putting it about $85 million short of $1 billion less than a month after its Aug. 25 listing. According to NS3.AI, ZEC traded around $1,540 on Sept. 19, while futures open interest reached about $3.5 billion and trading volume exceeded $10 billion. Grayscale also announced a 3-for-1 forward split for ZCSH, with split-adjusted trading expected to begin Sept. 30.

data.title: Paid Launches Token Issuance Feature on Pons
data.description: Paid said on X that it has launched token issuance functionality on Pons. According to ChainCatcher, 80% of fees will be sent to X users via X Money, while 20% will be converted into SOL to buy back PAID tokens. Issuers can add an X handle to the project description to send fees through X Money.

data.title: Polymarket Bitcoin September 19 Breakout Bet Sees Sharp Swing in 82,000 Yes Odds
data.description: Catcher Predict monitoring showed that the "Yes" option for the "82,000" submarket in Polymarket's "Bitcoin breaks through on September 19" event rose sharply from 7% one hour earlier to 24.1% at the time of reporting. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 17.1 percentage point swing and came amid attention to possible breaking news impacts.

data.title: Iran Says It Set Negotiating Conditions for the U.S. Through Qatar and Pakistan
data.description: According to Sina Finance, Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei said on Saturday that Iran has set negotiating conditions for the U.S. through mediators in Qatar and Pakistan: a complete end to fighting on all fronts, the release of seized Iranian assets, and the lifting of the naval blockade. Rezaei said Tehran remains in contact with the Qatari mediator, who has conveyed Iran's conditions to the U.S. in an effort to end the war, and is now waiting for a response from U.S. President Donald Trump.
